idea-plugin.name: DORA Art. 30 ICT Contract Clause Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Twenty-two checks over the ICT vendor contracts in your repository - every missing Article 30 clause named, with the wording to paste in.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → DORA Art. 30 ICT Contract Clause Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 22 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/dora-ict-contract-clause-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/dora-ict-contract-clause-lint

action.text: DORA Art. 30 ICT Contract Clause Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run DORA Art. 30 ICT Contract Clause Lint on the file in the editor
